_note: Payon Stories custom cards: the word they lend to a host item's name. The client's own cardprefixnametable (card_names.json, generated from the official tables) only knows vanilla cards, so every PS custom is absent from it and contributes no word until it is listed here. Hand-maintained from what the game shows — the PS item API does not publish these.
_format: id -> { n: "word", after: true when it follows the item name }
_source: maintainer, reading the name off the item in-game
